voice.welcome: Welcome to Snack Chef! Tap a yummy picture and let us make it.
voice.nudge: Almost! Put it on the glowing spot.
voice.fruit-intro: Let us make a silly fruit face!
voice.fruit-cut: Swipe across each dotted line to slice the kiwi.
voice.fruit-arrange: Give our snack two kiwi eyes, a berry nose, and a banana smile.
voice.fruit-cheer: Hello, fruit face! You made a delicious smile.
voice.toast-intro: Let us paint a tiny toast garden!
voice.toast-spread: Move in big circles and spread to every corner.
voice.toast-arrange: Plant the banana flowers and add bright berry centers.
voice.toast-cheer: Your toast garden is blooming. Beautiful chef work!
voice.boat-intro: Let us build a crunchy banana boat!
voice.boat-peel: Pull each peel strip down, down, down.
voice.boat-cut: Swipe across the four dotted lines to make banana coins.
voice.boat-arrange: Fill the boat from left to right, then sprinkle the berries.
voice.boat-cheer: All aboard the banana boat. Bon voyage, chef!
